feeds.title: CUInsight
feeds.description: CUInsight is the place for all things credit union and host of The CUInsight Experience podcast. They are the leading digital source connecting the credit union community to news, community, opinion, press, career opportunities, events, trusted partners, and each other. CUInsight's commitment is to the credit union movement and the people who make it amazing.

feeds.title: NACUSO
feeds.description: The National Association of Credit Union Service Organizations (NACUSO) was formed in 1985 to help credit unions explore the use of CUSOs and the delivery of non-traditional products and services. Over the years, NACUSO's focus has evolved to helping credit unions form multi-owned CUSOs and participate in collaboration and the cooperative business model.

feeds.title: Service Federal Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Our blog provides financial tips to help you make better financial decisions throughout your day-to-day. We're committed to personalized service that goes above and beyond what you'll find at any other financial institution.

feeds.title: SAFE Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Simple strategies for financial and community wellness. Since 1940, we've been helping people make their financial dreams become realities and turning financial relationships into friendships. It's all about putting YOU first.

feeds.title: Consumers Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Consumers Credit Union financial tips and money management blog to get the financial advice you need to solve all life's little budget problems. Our mission is to provide quality and innovative products and services that contribute to the economic and social well-being of our membership.

feeds.title: Vermont Federal Blog
feeds.description: Vermont Federal is a full service, not-for-profit, cooperative financial institution that has been serving Vermonters for over 60 years.

feeds.title: Directions Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest financial news, tips and education from the experts at Directions Credit Union. Directions Credit Union is a community-based organization dedicated to serving the financial needs of its members.

feeds.title: The Peoples Federal Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: The People's Federal Credit Union likes educating our members by sharing useful, educational, financial, budgeting, and investment ideas and tips in our blog posts. The People's Federal Credit Union is a member-owned federally chartered credit union committed to serving the financial needs of its members.

feeds.title: Verve Blog
feeds.description: People helping people is what credit unions were founded on, and it's what we live and breathe at Verve. Verve, a Credit Union is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative with membership and banking services.

feeds.title: Gulf Coast Educators Federal Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Gulf Coast Educators FCU is open to serve the financial needs of all school employees and their families within the state of Texas.

feeds.title: Members Plus Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Members Plus Credit Union blog! We will be providing you with tips, helpful information, financial advice as well as letting you in on our opinion!

feeds.title: America's Credit Unions
feeds.description: Your daily starting point for credit union news. Credit Union National Association is the most influential financial services trade association and the only national association that advocates on behalf of all of America's credit unions.

feeds.title: People First Blog
feeds.description: People First Federal Credit Union is a federally chartered and insured credit union that has been serving the Lehigh Valley in Eastern Pennsylvania for over 65 years.

feeds.title: SouthPoint Financial Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest happenings at SouthPoint including helpful tips and articles on home loans, financial wellness, and our impact on the community. SouthPoint Financial Credit Union empowers members to achieve their goals and dreams by providing exceptional service and guidance.

feeds.title: Embold Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Latest news from Clackamas Federal Credit Union. We are dedicated to the financial success of our members. Our financial blog is one of the many tools we offer to help you achieve your goals. We're a not-for-profit cooperative dedicated to your financial success.

feeds.title: Florida Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Florida Credit Union's blog on financial topics such as credit, fraud prevention, budgeting advice, education for students and more. Florida Credit Union is a full-service, not-for-profit financial institution in North Central Florida, chartered for the sole purpose of helping consumers and businesses.

feeds.title: Resource One Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog for financial tips and other Resource One Credit Union related news, updates, and events! At Resource One Credit Union, we help hard-working Texans achieve their financial goals. We are a Credit Union, owned by our members and working to give them control of their future.

feeds.title: Foundation Credit Union Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with all the latest from Foundation Credit Union, including news about us, service information, announcements, and more.Foundation Credit Union is small enough to know you and large enough to serve you. Founded in 1933, we've been in business for nearly 90 years! We have deep ties to the Ozarks built on a foundation of trust and service to our community.
